module.exports = async (params) => {
  const { app, quickAddApi, obsidian } = params;
  const Notice = obsidian.Notice;
  const MarkdownView = obsidian.MarkdownView;
  const TFile = obsidian.TFile;

  const stop = (message) => {
    new Notice(message);
    if (typeof params.abort === "function") return params.abort(message);
    throw new Error(message);
  };

  const file = app.workspace.getActiveFile();
  if (!file || !(file instanceof TFile)) {
    return stop("開いているノートがありません");
  }
  if (file.path.startsWith("02_Configs/Log/")) {
    return stop("日次ログではなく、積み上げたいタスクノートを開いて実行してください");
  }

  const memoRaw = await quickAddApi.inputPrompt("メモ");
  if (memoRaw == null) {
    return stop("キャンセルしました");
  }
  const memo = String(memoRaw).trim();

  let current = getEditorOrFileText(app, MarkdownView, file);
  if (current == null) {
    current = await app.vault.read(file);
  }

  const nextRaw = await quickAddApi.inputPrompt(
    "次回",
    "",
    currentNextAction(current)
  );
  if (nextRaw == null) {
    return stop("キャンセルしました");
  }
  const next = submittedNextText(nextRaw);
  if (!memo && !next) {
    return stop("メモも次回も空なので中止しました");
  }

  const moment = window.moment;
  const date = moment().format("YYYY-MM-DD");
  const withNext = next ? replaceFirstOpenNext(current, next) : current;
  const checkedDone = !next && allNextChecked(withNext);
  const titleAction = next ? firstOpenNext(sectionNextItems(withNext)) : "";
  const left = next || checkedDone ? currentLabel(withNext) : "";
  let content = upsertTitle(withNext, file.basename, titleAction, left, checkedDone);
  if (memo) {
    content = insertAfterLogHeading(content, `- ${date} ${memo}\n--- `);
  }
  await setEditorOrFileText(app, MarkdownView, file, content);

  if (memo) {
    await appendDailyLog(app, TFile, file, memo, moment);
  }
  await reloadTaskChuteIfOpen(app);
  if (memo && app.isMobile) {
    new Notice("日次ログに書きました。Synctrainで同期してください", 8000);
  } else if (memo) {
    new Notice("ノートと日次ログに書きました");
  } else if (app.isMobile) {
    new Notice("次の一手を書き換えました。Synctrainで同期してください", 8000);
  } else {
    new Notice("次の一手を書き換えました");
  }
};

function getEditorOrFileText(app, MarkdownView, file) {
  const view = app.workspace.getActiveViewOfType(MarkdownView);
  if (view && view.file && view.file.path === file.path) {
    return view.editor.getValue();
  }
  return null;
}

async function setEditorOrFileText(app, MarkdownView, file, next) {
  const view = app.workspace.getActiveViewOfType(MarkdownView);
  if (view && view.file && view.file.path === file.path) {
    view.editor.setValue(next);
    return;
  }
  if (typeof app.vault.process === "function") {
    await app.vault.process(file, () => next);
    return;
  }
  await app.vault.modify(file, next);
}

function yamlQuote(value) {
  return `"${String(value).replace(/\\/g, "\\\\").replace(/"/g, '\\"')}"`;
}

function titleMark(existingTitle) {
  const existing = String(existingTitle || "").trim();
  if (existing.startsWith("★")) return "★";
  if (existing.startsWith("◆")) return "◆";
  if (existing.startsWith("◎")) return "◎";
  return "";
}

function currentLabel(source) {
  const text = source == null ? "" : source;
  const headingRe = /^## いまやること[ \t]*$/m;
  const m = headingRe.exec(text);
  if (!m) return "";
  const headingEnd = m.index + m[0].length;
  const after = text.slice(headingEnd);
  const nextH = /^## /m.exec(after);
  const section = nextH ? after.slice(0, nextH.index) : after;
  const lines = section.split(/\r?\n/);
  for (const raw of lines) {
    const line = String(raw).trim();
    if (!line) continue;
    return line.replace(/^-+\s*/, "").trim();
  }
  return "";
}

function parseNextLine(raw) {
  const line = String(raw).trim();
  if (!line) return null;
  const match = /^(?:[-*+][ \t]*)?(?:\[([ xX])\][ \t]*)?([\s\S]*)$/.exec(line);
  if (!match) return null;
  const text = String(match[2] || "").trim();
  if (!text) return null;
  const mark = match[1];
  return { kind: "item", checked: mark === "x" || mark === "X", text };
}

function parseNextLines(raw) {
  const lines = String(raw == null ? "" : raw).split(/\r?\n/);
  const items = [];
  let started = false;
  for (const rawLine of lines) {
    const parsed = parseNextLine(rawLine);
    if (!parsed) {
      if (!started) continue;
      if (items.length && items[items.length - 1].kind !== "blank") {
        items.push({ kind: "blank" });
      }
      continue;
    }
    started = true;
    items.push(parsed);
  }
  while (items.length && items[items.length - 1].kind === "blank") items.pop();
  return items;
}

function submittedNextText(raw) {
  const first = String(raw == null ? "" : raw).split(/\r?\n/)[0];
  const parsed = parseNextLine(first);
  return parsed ? parsed.text : "";
}

function sectionNextItems(source) {
  const text = source == null ? "" : source;
  const headingRe = /^## 次の一手[ \t]*$/m;
  const m = headingRe.exec(text);
  if (!m) return [];
  const headingEnd = m.index + m[0].length;
  const after = text.slice(headingEnd);
  const nextH = /^## /m.exec(after);
  const section = nextH ? after.slice(0, nextH.index) : after;
  return parseNextLines(section);
}

function formatNextSection(items) {
  return items
    .map((item) => {
      if (item.kind === "blank") return "";
      return item.checked ? `- [x] ${item.text}` : `- [ ] ${item.text}`;
    })
    .join("\n");
}

function allNextChecked(source) {
  const items = sectionNextItems(source).filter((item) => item.kind === "item");
  return items.length > 0 && items.every((item) => item.checked);
}

function firstOpenNext(items) {
  for (const item of items) {
    if (item.kind === "item" && !item.checked) return item.text;
  }
  return "";
}

function currentNextAction(source) {
  return firstOpenNext(sectionNextItems(source));
}

function replaceFirstOpenNext(content, text) {
  const wording = String(text || "").trim();
  if (!wording) return content == null ? "" : content;
  const source = content == null ? "" : content;
  const items = sectionNextItems(source);
  let replaced = false;
  for (const item of items) {
    if (item.kind === "item" && !item.checked) {
      item.text = wording;
      replaced = true;
      break;
    }
  }
  if (!replaced) items.push({ kind: "item", checked: false, text: wording });
  return writeNextSection(source, items);
}

function titleText(basename, next, existingTitle, leftOverride) {
  const left = String(leftOverride || "").trim() || String(basename);
  const mark = titleMark(existingTitle);
  const name = mark && !left.startsWith(mark) ? `${mark}${left}` : left;
  if (!next) return name;
  const action = String(next).replace(/\r?\n/g, " ").trim();
  return `${name}｜${action}`;
}

function frontmatterBounds(source) {
  if (!source.startsWith("---")) return null;
  const nl = source.indexOf("\n");
  if (nl === -1) return null;
  if (source.slice(0, nl).replace(/\r$/, "") !== "---") return null;
  const rest = source.slice(nl + 1);
  const close = rest.search(/^---[ \t]*\r?$/m);
  if (close === -1) return null;
  const bodyStart = nl + 1;
  const bodyEnd = bodyStart + close;
  return { bodyStart, bodyEnd };
}

function titleLineInfo(source) {
  const bounds = frontmatterBounds(source);
  if (!bounds) return { bounds: null, hasValue: false, value: "" };
  const body = source.slice(bounds.bodyStart, bounds.bodyEnd);
  const match = /^title:[ \t]*([^\r\n]*)$/m.exec(body);
  if (!match) return { bounds, hasValue: false, value: "" };
  const raw = match[1].trim();
  let value = raw;
  if (
    (raw.startsWith('"') && raw.endsWith('"') && raw.length >= 2) ||
    (raw.startsWith("'") && raw.endsWith("'") && raw.length >= 2)
  ) {
    value = raw.slice(1, -1);
  }
  return {
    bounds,
    hasValue: value.trim() !== "",
    value,
    lineStart: bounds.bodyStart + match.index,
    lineEnd: bounds.bodyStart + match.index + match[0].length,
  };
}

function upsertTitle(content, basename, next, leftOverride, forceLeftOnly) {
  const source = content == null ? "" : content;
  const info = titleLineInfo(source);
  if (!next && info.hasValue && !forceLeftOnly) return source;
  const line = `title: ${yamlQuote(titleText(basename, next, info.value, leftOverride))}`;
  if (!info.bounds) {
    const body = source.length === 0 || source.startsWith("\n") ? source : `\n${source}`;
    return `---\n${line}\n---\n${body}`;
  }
  if (info.lineStart != null) {
    return source.slice(0, info.lineStart) + line + source.slice(info.lineEnd);
  }
  const before = source.slice(0, info.bounds.bodyEnd);
  const pad = before.endsWith("\n") ? "" : "\n";
  return before + pad + line + "\n" + source.slice(info.bounds.bodyEnd);
}

function writeNextSection(content, items) {
  if (!items.some((item) => item.kind === "item")) {
    return content == null ? "" : content;
  }
  const source = content == null ? "" : content;
  const line = formatNextSection(items);
  const headingRe = /^## 次の一手[ \t]*$/m;
  const m = headingRe.exec(source);
  if (m) {
    const headingEnd = m.index + m[0].length;
    const after = source.slice(headingEnd);
    const nextH = /^## /m.exec(after);
    const sectionEnd = nextH ? headingEnd + nextH.index : source.length;
    const before = source.slice(0, headingEnd);
    const afterSection = source.slice(sectionEnd);
    if (!afterSection) {
      return before + "\n\n" + line + "\n";
    }
    return before + "\n\n" + line + "\n\n" + afterSection;
  }

  const block = `## 次の一手\n\n${line}\n`;
  const logRe = /^## ログ[ \t]*$/m;
  const logM = logRe.exec(source);
  if (logM) {
    let prefix = source.slice(0, logM.index);
    if (prefix.length > 0 && !prefix.endsWith("\n")) {
      prefix += "\n";
    }
    return prefix + `## 次の一手\n\n${line}\n\n` + source.slice(logM.index);
  }

  if (source.length === 0) {
    return block;
  }
  const pad = source.endsWith("\n") ? "" : "\n";
  return `${source}${pad}\n${block}`;
}

function insertAfterLogHeading(content, line) {
  const source = content == null ? "" : content;
  const re = /^## ログ[ \t]*$/m;
  const m = re.exec(source);
  if (!m) {
    const pad = source.endsWith("\n") || source.length === 0 ? "" : "\n";
    return `${source}${pad}\n## ログ\n\n${line}\n`;
  }
  const headingEnd = m.index + m[0].length;
  let j = headingEnd;
  while (j < source.length && (source[j] === "\n" || source[j] === "\r")) j++;
  return source.slice(0, headingEnd) + "\n\n" + line + "\n" + source.slice(j);
}

async function appendDailyLog(app, TFile, sourceFile, memo, moment) {
  const date = moment().format("YYYY-MM-DD");
  const time = moment().format("HH:mm");
  const nextDate = moment().add(1, "days").format("YYYY-MM-DD");
  const prevDate = moment().subtract(1, "days").format("YYYY-MM-DD");
  const path = `02_Configs/Log/${date}.md`;
  const generate = app.fileManager && app.fileManager.generateMarkdownLink;
  const link =
    typeof generate === "function"
      ? generate.call(app.fileManager, sourceFile, path)
      : `[[${sourceFile.basename}]]`;
  const entry = `- ${time} ${link} ${memo}\n--- \n`;

  let file = app.vault.getAbstractFileByPath(path);
  if (!file) {
    const body =
      `---\nStart: ${date}\nEnd: ${nextDate}\n---\n` +
      `[[${prevDate}]] ｜ [[${nextDate}]]\n\n\n${entry}`;
    await app.vault.create(path, body);
    return;
  }
  if (!(file instanceof TFile)) return;

  const transform = (data) => {
    const base = data.endsWith("\n") ? data : data + "\n";
    return base + entry;
  };
  if (typeof app.vault.process === "function") {
    await app.vault.process(file, transform);
    return;
  }
  const data = await app.vault.read(file);
  await app.vault.modify(file, transform(data));
}

async function reloadTaskChuteIfOpen(app) {
  const leaf = app.workspace.getLeavesOfType("taskchute-view")[0];
  const view = leaf && leaf.view;
  if (view && typeof view.reloadTasksAndRestore === "function") {
    await view.reloadTasksAndRestore({ runBoundaryCheck: true });
  }
}
